children.value: > Fact From Story The highly anticipated criminal trial for Sam Bankman-Fried, former CEO of bankrupt crypto exchange FTX, started Tuesday to determine whether he’s guilty of seven counts of fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story The 31-year-old co-founded FTX in 2019; within a few years the once third-largest crypto exchange’s valuation hit $32 billion at its peak.
> > > Fact From Story SBF is in court for allegedly committing fraud and money laundering while leading crypto exchange FTX and sister company Alameda.
> > > Fact From Story SBF was the former CEO and co-founder of FTX.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Fraud and conspiracy are crimes.
> > Commonsense Knowledge A CEO is the leader of a company.
> Commonsense Knowledge A trial begins when it starts on its determined date.
